mapper.sql: SELECT b.block_seq AS sequence, b.block_type AS type, COALESCE(NULLIF(b.block_text,''), bi.image_caption, bt.table_caption, bf.footnote_text, (SELECT string_agg(r.reference_text, CHR(10) ORDER BY r.reference_seq) FROM block_reference r WHERE r.block_id = b.block_id)) AS text, COALESCE(b.pdf_page, 0) AS page, CASE WHEN a.path LIKE 'openalex/%' OR a.path LIKE 'paperflow/%' THEN a.path WHEN a.path IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE( (SELECT regexp_replace(tf.file_path, '/[^/]*$', '') || '/' FROM text_file tf WHERE tf.file_id = b.file_id ORDER BY tf.file_type LIMIT 1), '') || a.path END AS image_path, jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object( 'bbox', b.pdf_bbox, 'titleLevel', b.title_level, 'imageCaption', bi.image_caption, 'imageFootnote', bi.image_footnote, 'tableCaption', bt.table_caption, 'tableFootnote', bt.table_footnote, 'equationFormat', be.format, 'footnoteLabel', bf.footnote_label, 'footnoteText', bf.footnote_text ))::text AS attributes FROM block b LEFT JOIN block_image bi ON bi.block_id = b.block_id LEFT JOIN block_table bt ON bt.block_id = b.block_id LEFT JOIN block_equation be ON be.block_id = b.block_id LEFT JOIN block_footnote bf ON bf.block_id = b.block_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(bi.image_path, bt.image_path, be.image_path) AS path) a WHERE b.file_id = #{paperId} AND b.block_type != 'discarded'
